# dsh-session-title-stamp
English | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness title provider for a configurable `DATE | CATEGORY | NAME`
title. Beyond automati

k Harness title provider for a configurable `DATE | CATEGORY | NAME`
title. Beyond automatic naming:

- **Auto refresh** — after a completed turn, with a 2-minute cooldown and a
100-message freeze; fork

s and user-pinned titles are skipped.
- **Generate title** — the conversation-header ↻ button, the s

ession row's
**Generate title** menu item, or `/retitle`.
- **Copy title** — an extra item in the se

ssion `···` menu copies the full title.
- **Settings page** — preview and change format, emoji, titl

e language, and refresh cadence without editing YAML.
- **Optional category emoji** — `categoryEmoji

: true` renders titles such as
`1027 | ⚡ 优化 | ...`.
- **Hover stats** — see duration, estimated CNY

cost, and token count at a glance,
without opening a dashboard.
- **Category language** — `categoryP

reset: zh | en`, or your own `categories`.
- **Title language** — names can follow the conversation,

or be forced to Chinese/English.
- **Failure-safe** — a failed retitle keeps the current title.
- *
*Zero build** — pure Host logic plus a small hand-written browser half.

> **The title tells you what the session was about; the hover card tells you what it cost.**
> Durat
ion, estimated CNY, and tokens are one hover away — no dashboard.
Default format:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For example, with `categoryPreset: en`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Dates are computed by the plugin from the session's creation time, never by the
model. Categories ar

e chosen from a small configurable taxonomy and validated
locally. The model only proposes the categ

ory and the name; the provider owns
the final format. The default taxonomy is Chinese; set `category

Preset: en` for
the English labels above.
## Why

Long-lived workspaces collect dozens of sessions whose titles are either the
first few words of the

first message or an auto-summary that drifts. A fixed
`date | category | name` convention makes the

sidebar scannable across projects,
and mirrors conventions used by other coding agents.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`.
- A working model route for the session; the title request

uses the session's
current provider/model unless `provider`/`model` are configured.
## Install
### DSH Desktop / Web with Discover
Add this market index source in **Plugins → Discover → Index sources**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then install **Session title stamp** from the list. The plugin installs as a
profile bundle and appe

ars in the Plugins page, where it can be enabled or
disabled like any other bundle.
### CLI
From GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From npm:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For a local checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The Electron Desktop profile is managed by the application; use its Plugins
page rather than `dsh pl
ugin --profile desktop`.

The bundle patch disables the shipped `session-title-llm` row and inserts this
provider. Do not enab

le the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-titles-bundle` at the same time: both
replace

the same provider slot, and the title service accepts only one provider.
If another provider wins t

he registration race, this plugin logs a warning and
stays inactive instead of failing startup.
## How it works

- `cordis.patch.yml` disables `session-title-llm` and inserts the
`session-title-stamp` row from thi

s package.
- `lib/index.js` registers a provider through `ctx.sessionTitle.register()` and
reuses `@

deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-llm` for route selection, timeouts,
cancellation, token limits, and ex

act auxiliary-request logging.
- `lib/format.js` is dependency-free: local-time date parts, template

rendering,
category validation, name sanitizing, and UTF-8 byte truncation.

The provider computes the date from `session.header.createdAt` in the host's
local time zone, asks t

he model for `{"category":"...","name":"..."}`, validates
the category, and renders the template. Em

pty `{type}` or `{topic}` segments
remove their neighbouring separator instead of leaving `||`.
### Retitle cadence

The provider is registered as `first-prompt`, so the title service names the
session once. After tha

t, the plugin refreshes on a completed turn (`turn/end`)
with two guards:

- **cooldown** — at most one automatic refresh every `refreshMinIntervalMs`
(default 2 minutes), so

a fast first answer does not generate twice;
- **freeze** — after `refreshMaxTurns` user messages (d

efault 100), automatic
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and cost

- The first eligible user message plus up to `recentMessages - 1` recent
messages are sent to the mo

del. Message text is framed as JSON to keep user
content from breaking delimiters.
- The request use

s the session's configured provider/model, or the optional
`provider`/`model` override. The plugin m

akes no other network calls and
collects no telemetry.
- One auxiliary request is made for the first

title, then at most one per
completed turn inside the cooldown, and none after the freeze threshold

ytes`, and `timeoutMs` bound it.
- The resulting title is stored in the session log as a normal `ses

sion/title`
event. A manual rename pins the title and later automatic revisions do not
overwrite it.
## Compatibility notes

- This package targets the DSH 0.2 line. `engines.dsh` refuses to install it on
0.3+ until it is upd

ated against the new title API.
- The bundle assumes the shipped row id `session-title-llm`. If anot

her title
provider is registered first, this plugin logs and stays inactive; disable the
other provi

der and reload.
- `llm`, `commands`, `sessions`, `sessionProjections`, and `connection` are
awaited

lazily; a composition without one still loads the plugin and degrades
only the affected feature.
- T

he browser half needs the Web composition's `sidebar.session.row.hover` and
`conversation.session.he

ader.actions` seats. A shell that does not expose them
simply shows no button/hover line.
- The prov

ider imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-llm` dynamically. A
missing or incompatible executor de

grades to local naming, but a changed
`ctx.sessionTitle` API can prevent registration. Pin the DSH r

ange when
publishing a release.
